    How these numbers work

    Krea sells video through monthly allowances of compute units, not a price per second. Every price on this page is our estimate from Krea's own USD plan data: the plan price, the compute units it includes, and the compute units each clip uses.

    PlanPriceCompute units a month$ per unitChecked

    Compute units per clip and clips each plan includes

    ModelClip lengthCompute units per clipClips a month on Basic (yearly)Clips a month on Pro (monthly)Clips a month on Pro (yearly)
    Wan 3.0 Prime2s~101~49~198~198
    Wan 3.02s~111~45~180~180
    Kling 3.0 Standard3s~187~26~107~107
    Veo 3.1 Fast4s~238~21~84~84
    Veo 3.1 Lite4s~89~56~225~225
    Hailuo 2.36s~208~24~96~96
    MiniMax H3 Max5s~139~36~144~144
    Runway Gen-4.52s~179~28~112~112
    • Price per second = plan price per month ÷ compute units a month × compute units per clip ÷ clip length in seconds. The 10-second cost is that rate × 10. A model whose longest clip is shorter than 10 seconds needs more than one clip, and the row says how many.
    • Krea publishes approximate clip counts ("~") for its plans. We divide the plan's compute units by that count to get the compute units per clip, so every row is labelled estimated from credit plan.
    • Example: Veo 3.1 Lite on Basic (yearly) is $5/mo ÷ 5,000 compute units = $0.00100 per unit; × ~88.9 compute units per 4s clip = $0.089 a clip; ÷ 4 seconds = $0.0222/s. That plan's 5,000 compute units make about 56 such clips a month.
    • Every row on this page assumes every credit you pay for is used. Unused compute units make the real cost per second higher.
    • A sale plan shows its regular price next to it. When the sale ends, the sale labels go away and the next daily check moves the rows to the regular plan price once Krea's page shows it.
    • Krea also sells Basic on monthly billing and a Max plan. Our price data has no rows for them yet, so they are not priced here. Only models VidFare covers are listed.
    • This page rebuilds with every daily price check. If any row on it goes more than 7 days without a check, the page shows a notice and is hidden from search until it is re-checked. Oldest check on this page: Nov 20, 2026.
